title: ONE GROWING DAMAGE NUMBER AND YOUR HURT IN RED
why: His g-84 and g-85 answers on 10-25: Yes, one growing number; Yes, red numbers. Shotgun pellets and rapid bursts crowded the fight, and solo hurt had no number over you. Watch: one climbing number should read cleaner in shotgun, LMG and SMG fights; check a weak point still stands out in its own colour, two players on one enemy stay readable, and your red numbers do not crowd your body or reticle.
now: Hits on the same target and in the same colour grow one number within half a second. Your own hurt shows red above you in solo and co-op, with the health bar feedback kept.
